# The Lighthouse Robot

Student: Corwin Ashgrove

If I could invent anything, I would build a robot that lives in a lighthouse. The robot would climb the stairs every night and turn on the big lamp so ships do not crash on the rocks. It would also clean the windows after storms. My robot would have long arms, a battery that charges from the wind, and a radio to call the coast guard if it sees a boat in trouble. I think a lighthouse robot is a good idea because the keeper could finally sleep through the night.
